SELECT m.id, m.title, m.content, m.msg_type AS msgType, m.audience_type AS audienceType, m.class_name_text AS classNameText, m.target_count AS targetCount, m.receiver_count AS receiverCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wx_message_receiver r WHERE r.message_id = m.id AND r.read_flag = 1) AS readCount, m.sender, m.sent_at AS sentAt, m.created_at AS createdAt FROM wx_message m
AND (m.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND m.msg_type = #{msgType} AND m.sent_at >= #{start} AND m.sent_at < DATE_ADD(#{end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
ORDER BY m.sent_at DESC, m.id DESC

SELECT r.id, r.student_name AS studentName, COALESCE(NULLIF(p.nickname, ''), p.phone, '未设置昵称') AS parentName, p.phone AS parentPhone, r.read_flag AS readFlag, r.read_at AS readAt, r.created_at AS createdAt FROM wx_message_receiver r LEFT JOIN wx_parent p ON p.id = r.parent_id WHERE r.message_id = #{messageId} AND r.read_flag = #{readFlag} ORDER BY r.read_flag ASC, r.id ASC
SELECT name FROM class_group WHERE id IN #{id} ORDER BY name
SELECT DISTINCT s.id, s.name FROM class_student cs JOIN student s ON s.id = cs.student_id WHERE cs.status = '在读' AND cs.class_id IN #{id} ORDER BY s.name
SELECT DISTINCT s.id, s.name FROM wx_parent_student ps JOIN student s ON s.id = ps.student_id ORDER BY s.name
SELECT id, name FROM student WHERE id IN #{id} ORDER BY name
SELECT student_id AS studentId, parent_id AS parentId FROM wx_parent_student WHERE student_id IN #{id}
